data.collector.yaml:
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 384
    spike_limit_mib: 64
  transform/redact_content:
    error_mode: propagate
    trace_statements:
      - 'set(resource.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.namespace"], "agentsec")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-api" and resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-worker"'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.version"], "redacted")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "development" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "test" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "staging" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "production"'
      - 'set(scope.name, "redacted")'
      - 'set(scope.version, "")'
      - 'set(scope.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(scope.attributes, {})'
      - 'set(span.name, "redacted")'
      - 'set(span.status.message, "")'
      - 'set(span.trace_state, "")'
      - 'set(spanevent.name, "redacted")'
    metric_statements:
      - 'set(resource.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.namespace"], "agentsec")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-api" and resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-worker"'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.version"], "redacted")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "development" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "test" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "staging" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "production"'
      - 'set(scope.name, "redacted")'
      - 'set(scope.version, "")'
      - 'set(scope.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(scope.attributes, {})'
      - 'set(metric.description, "")'
      - 'set(metric.unit, "")'
      - 'set(metric.metadata, {})'
      - 'set(exemplar.filtered_attributes, {})'
    log_statements:
      - 'set(resource.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.namespace"], "agentsec")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-api" and resource.attributes["service.name"] != "agentsec-worker"'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["service.version"], "redacted")'
      - 'set(resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"], "unknown") where resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "development" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "test" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "staging" and resource.attributes["deployment.environment.name"] != "production"'
      - 'set(scope.name, "redacted")'
      - 'set(scope.version, "")'
      - 'set(scope.schema_url, "")'
      - 'set(scope.attributes, {})'
      - 'set(log.body, "")'
      - 'set(log.event_name, "redacted")'
      - 'set(log.severity_text, "")'
  filter/drop_unsafe_trace_links:
    error_mode: propagate
    trace_conditions:
      - 'Len(span.links) > 0'
  filter/allow_metrics:
    error_mode: propagate
    metric_conditions:
      - 'metric.name != "agentsec_ready" and metric.name != "agentsec_build_info" and metric.name != "zasp_http_requests_total" and metric.name != "zasp_http_request_duration_seconds" and metric.name != "zasp_http_slo_requests_total" and metric.name != "zasp_http_slo_request_duration_seconds" and metric.name != "zasp_http_rate_limited_total" and metric.name != "zasp_auth_rejections_total" and metric.name != "zasp_dependency_operations_total" and metric.name != "zasp_job_operations_total" and metric.name != "zasp_postgres_pool_connections" and metric.name != "zasp_metrics_render_overflow" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_claimed_total" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_active" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_inflight" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_lease_loss_total" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_retry_total" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_exhaustion_total" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_failure_total" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_driver_ready" and metric.name != "zasp_worker_projection_backlog_age_seconds"'
  redaction:
    allow_all_keys: false
    allowed_keys:
      - service.name
      - service.namespace
      - service.version
      - deployment.environment.name
    redact_all_types: true
    blocked_key_patterns:
      - '(?i).*(?:authorization|cookie|credential|password|secret|token|api[_-]?key).*'
    blocked_values:
      - '(?i)bearer[ ]+[a-z0-9._~+/-]+=*'
      - '(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|password|secret|token)=[^&[:space:]]+'
    summary: silent
  batch:
    send_batch_size: 512
    send_batch_max_size: 1024
    timeout: 5s
exporters:
  nop: {}
service:
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      readers:
        - pull:
            exporter:
              prometheus:
                host: 0.0.0.0
                port: 8888
  extensions: [health_check]
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, filter/drop_unsafe_trace_links, transform/redact_content, redaction, batch]
      exporters: [nop]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, transform/redact_content, filter/allow_metrics, redaction, batch]
      exporters: [nop]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, transform/redact_content, redaction, batch]
      exporters: [nop]

containers.name: nango
args:
node --input-type=module --eval 'const values = [process.env.NANGO_DATABASE_URL, process.env.RECORDS_DATABASE_URL]; let url; try { url = new URL(values[0]); } catch {} const keys = url ? [...url.searchParams.keys()] : []; if (!url || values.some((value) => value !== values[0]) || !["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol) || !url.username || !url.password || !url.hostname || url.port !== "5432" || url.pathname.length < 2 || url.hash || keys.length !== 1 || keys[0] !== "sslmode" || url.searchParams.get("sslmode") !== "verify-full") process.exit(64);'
exec node packages/server/dist/server.js

containers.name: migrate
args:
node --input-type=module --eval 'const values = [process.env.NANGO_DATABASE_URL, process.env.RECORDS_DATABASE_URL]; let url; try { url = new URL(values[0]); } catch {} const keys = url ? [...url.searchParams.keys()] : []; if (!url || values.some((value) => value !== values[0]) || !["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol) || !url.username || !url.password || !url.hostname || url.port !== "5432" || url.pathname.length < 2 || url.hash || keys.length !== 1 || keys[0] !== "sslmode" || url.searchParams.get("sslmode") !== "verify-full") process.exit(64);'
exec node packages/server/dist/migrate.js
